# What usql prints for the describe commands on postgres-18, with dbrun's
# fixture examples. TestDescribe in drivers/dbrun_test.go writes this file.
# Do not edit it. Run the test with -update, and read the diff.

-- \dt authors
           List of tables
 Schema |  Name   | Type  |  Owner   
--------+---------+-------+----------
 public | authors | table | postgres
(1 row)


-- \dt books
          List of tables
 Schema | Name  | Type  |  Owner   
--------+-------+-------+----------
 public | books | table | postgres
(1 row)


-- \d authors
                       Table "public.authors"
  Column   |          Type          | Collation | Nullable | Default 
-----------+------------------------+-----------+----------+---------
 author_id | integer                |           | not null | 
 name      | character varying(100) |           | not null | 
Indexes:
    "authors_pkey" PRIMARY KEY, btree (author_id)
Referenced by:
    TABLE "books" CONSTRAINT "books_author_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (author_id) REFERENCES authors(author_id)


-- \d books
                        Table "public.books"
  Column   |          Type          | Collation | Nullable | Default 
-----------+------------------------+-----------+----------+---------
 book_id   | integer                |           | not null | 
 author_id | integer                |           |          | 
 title     | character varying(200) |           | not null | 
Indexes:
    "books_pkey" PRIMARY KEY, btree (book_id)
Foreign-key constraints:
    "books_author_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (author_id) REFERENCES authors(author_id)


-- \di *authors*
                  List of indexes
 Schema |     Name     | Type  |  Owner   |  Table  
--------+--------------+-------+----------+---------
 public | authors_pkey | index | postgres | authors
(1 row)


-- \di *books*
                List of indexes
 Schema |    Name    | Type  |  Owner   | Table 
--------+------------+-------+----------+-------
 public | books_pkey | index | postgres | books
(1 row)
